derivation_or_objection: The outer phase has unit modulus. Cauchy-Schwarz over X_I bounds the square of the expectation by the expectation of the conditional square. Expanding with an independent X_J copy gives the phase difference and the product of characteristic functions.
independence_note: Only original coordinate independence is used.

hypotheses_used: all phase and characteristic-function factors bounded by one
derivation_or_objection: All measures are probabilities and all integrands are bounded, so Fubini applies. Taking absolute values removes the unit phase and bounds the expectation by the expectation of the product of absolute characteristic functions, yielding (4.4).
